introduction.title: A little about me
body: Hi there, I’m Darrel. My main career interests lie in cloud technology and automation. I’m also curious about the healthcare and psychology sectors, and I’m open to exploring opportunities in those fields. Outside of work, I spend my free time with friends and family, playing games, and trying new activities. My goal is to become a project manager in the future or to mentor the next generation, as I enjoy helping and teaching others.

After my National Service, I will study for a Bachelor of Science in Information Systems at Singapore Management University, continuing from my Diploma in Information Technology at Republic Polytechnic.

entries.title: Republic Polytechnic
body: Completed my Diploma in Information Technology, where I built a foundation in software development and cloud technology.

entries.title: DBS Asia Hub — Junior Application Developer
body: Worked with two other interns to integrate a scanner feature into a web application built with Angular and Spring Boot.
I was responsible for configuring the scanner, connecting it to the frontend controls, and ensuring payloads reached the backend correctly.

entries.title: Singapore Armed Forces — Admin Support Assistant
body: Began National Service as an NSF ASA in G1-Army, supporting data-related tasks, ad hoc requests, and team projects.

entries.title: NCS / IRAS — DevOps Engineer
body: Joined the IRIN3 project as a DevSecOps Engineer, supporting CI/CD pipelines, Azure services, AKS operations, and application-team queries.
The role strengthened my interest in cloud technology, automation, and how engineering teams deliver software in real working environments.
